caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects set against a plain, light beige background. The object on the left is a cylindrical, open container with smooth, rounded edges and horizontal grooves circling its body, indicating it is likely made of polished, dark brown wood. The container's thickness and the wood grain texture are clearly visible. To the right of this object lies a separate, flat, circular lid positioned with its inner surface facing up. The lid matches the container in both material and color, displaying similar wood grain patterns and a slightly recessed central area. Both the container and the lid cast subtle shadows on the background, suggesting a light source from the upper left. The artist’s signature, “P. Poffenbarger,” is visible in small print near the bottom right of the image.
title: Tobacco Box
